company.shortDescription: Reverie Labs is a machine learning-driven pharma company.
company.description: Reverie Labs (YC W18) is building a pharma company from scratch, using computation. Reverie Labs accelerates preclinical drug development by applying machine learning to lead generation & optimization.

productsAndServices.description: Develops deep-learning architectures to predict molecular properties such as on-target binding, toxicity, and ADMET for lead discovery and optimization.
productsAndServices.name: Supervised Machine Learning (ML)

productsAndServices.description: Enumerates and screens millions of compounds in virtual libraries for hit identification, combining medicinal chemistry expertise with machine learning models.
productsAndServices.name: Virtual Screening

productsAndServices.description: Uses simulation techniques and statistical ML to understand the energetics of bound ligands to protein targets and design kinase inhibitors.
productsAndServices.name: Computational Chemistry & Modeling

productsAndServices.description: Generates selective, synthesizable, stable, and tissue-penetrant molecules using computational techniques like genetic algorithms and continuous latent models.
productsAndServices.name: Algorithmic Molecular Generation

productsAndServices.description: Comprises wholly-owned drug candidates and those developed with partners, focusing on addressing limitations of current therapies and novel targets.
productsAndServices.name: Pipeline

productsAndServices.description: Builds rich data representations using diverse featurizations for small molecules and proteins, from SMILES methods to custom QM-based representations.
productsAndServices.name: Representation and Visualization
